versions.changelog:
- Expanded supported features to include modifying client business info/contact details (PATCH-style edits) and setting group, level, industry, and source tags via dedicated endpoints.
- Updated documentation to clarify editing workflows and highlight the use of specialized endpoints for classification/tag fields.
- Clarified API behavior for modifying clients, with emphasis on sending only fields that need changes.
- skill-card.md was removed.

- Expanded customer management: now supports editing company info, contact details, and category tags (group, level, industry, source) via new endpoints.
- Updated documentation to detail PATCH-style updates (only changed fields submitted).
- Clarified workflows for both adding and modifying customer records.
- Removed unnecessary file: skill-card.md.

- Added detailed reference files for customer and line/lead fields (`opencrm/references/fields.md`, `references/fields.md`)
- Updated SKILL.md: condensed interface/field details, added decision tables and workflow guides for all core CRM actions
- Removed redundant documentation file (`skill-card.md`)
- Clarified response handling, data display standards, and important restrictions (e.g. never expose internal IDs)
- Pointed to field references for complete field information, streamlining SKILL.md

- Initial release of opencrm skill for XTOCN CRM integration.
- Supports querying and adding customers and leads via API.
- Provides AI-powered extraction of customer information from unstructured text.
- Requires OPENCRM_KEY environment variable for authentication.
- Includes endpoints for customer and lead detail, list, and creation.

- Initial release of the opencrm skill.
- Supports querying and adding XTOCN CRM customers and leads via open API.
- Includes AI-powered structured data extraction from raw company text (e.g., from Qichacha or Tianyancha).
- Allows customer search by full name, credit code, or keyword, and supports detail and list queries.
- Provides endpoints for adding and viewing leads.
- Requires API Key authentication via the `OPENCRM_KEY` environment variable.
